name: control-room
description: The Control Room dashboard as a side pane in Claude Code, plus /control-room summary for anywhere a pane can't draw

dashboard_url.title: Dashboard URL
dashboard_url.description: Where the Control Room server answers. It binds to loopback, so the default is right unless you moved it.

auto_open.title: Open the pane when a session starts
auto_open.description: Opens the pane in interactive sessions. Claude Code only places a pane nobody asked for in a wide terminal: 144 columns, or 110 once you have opened it yourself.

refresh_seconds.title: Refresh interval in seconds
refresh_seconds.description: How often an open pane re-reads the dashboard.
